reviewed_changes: Fleet binary download/image conversion rechecks complete context after the final awaited blob; obsolete account, route, modal or page response cannot download/render under a replacement view.

Local search-only events in the destination and shipment pickers are excluded from edit-dirty state; inspected preparation picker preserves its chosen IDs during search, so this exclusion does not hide an operational edit.
The form close control distinguishes Cancel editing from Close window while calling the same close function; no logout/auth removal was introduced.
Receiving search uses shared accent folding and visible domain status; inaccessible stale site filter is cleared with an explanatory notice, without updating inventory data.
Dates shown to pt-BR are formatted with explicit UTC; original wire/stored values remain untouched.
CSS append stays within Fleet presentation classes: focus outline, wrapping, readable metadata and minimum control height; no hiding of permission or primary actions.
Shared mode choices validate native field/option/optgroup availability at click time; removed or disabled options cannot modify value or trigger a dirty event.
Actual received_damaged/returned_damaged statuses now remain visible in their appropriate packing filters and use domain labels.

findings.description: Avaria statuses were omitted from received and returned filters; independent test covers exact persisted states and rendered handler.

limitations: No browser or native dialog/keyboard implementation was used; DOM adapters execute actual controllers/components with fake transport and real exported HTTP bodies.
No screenshot, measured visual layout, actual mobile device or screen reader proof.
The new HTTP cases exercise the final backend through local TestClient with fictional DB; UI calls use mocked transport, so these are complementary proofs, not a browser-driven production flow.
Final reconstructed release-wide execution and any deployment remain the coordinator responsibility.
